The central, ornate structure is predominantly a vibrant magenta pink, richly adorned with intricate cream-colored architectural details including delicate columns, arched windows, decorative balustrades, and numerous spires and finials that crown its roofline. Each of its multiple stories features windows, many of which are fronted by balconies overflowing with hanging baskets of lush red and pink flowers, interspersed with potted green topiary plants. A central arched entrance, subtly lit, draws the eye towards the base of the building. A symmetrical garden leads up to the main entrance, featuring a paved pathway bordered on both sides by meticulously trimmed dark green hedges. Beyond the hedges, a vibrant array of rounded flowering bushes bloom in a gradient of colors, ranging from deep reds and bright oranges to various shades of pink and purple, creating a dazzling floral display. Small, perfectly spherical topiary trees stand at the garden's edge closer to the main building, contributing to the enchanting and well-manicured atmosphere. EXTERIOR VIEW.
